summary: Postinstall and import-time beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded VPS
details: The package ships a `beacon.cjs` script that collects host identifiers (os.hostname, install path from __dirname, process.cwd, node version, package name) and POSTs them as JSON to the hardcoded endpoint https://vmi3699893.contaboserver.net:8787/_ah/dc with TLS verification disabled (rejectUnauthorized: false). The beacon fires both from the `postinstall` lifecycle (on `npm install`) and from `index.js` on `require()`. The module itself exposes only a Proxy returning no-op functions for every property access, so the package provides no functionality matching its self-description as a compatibility shim — the beacon is the sole effect. The destination is a bare Contabo VPS unrelated to any declared publisher infrastructure, and the shape (inert functional surface + auto-firing callback on install and import to a hardcoded non-publisher host) is consistent with a dependency-confusion or reconnaissance beacon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
